how: Supanova Comic Con & Gaming holds an annual Sydney edition at Sydney Showground (Olympic Park; next June 2027) with a cosplay competition and a cosplay policy, so costume play is an annual convention activity rather than a weekly club.

The Society of Australian Genealogists runs lectures, workshops, tours, group meetings and online DNA and digital-skills programs, with a research library and archive at Richmond Villa, 120 Kent Street.
Dive Centre Manly offers guided snorkel tours, school snorkel tours, snorkel hire and a snorkel introduction course, with Shelly Beach / Cabbage Tree Bay Aquatic Reserve as the classic beginner site.
Flow mOcean runs SUP yoga, kayak yoga and beach yoga sessions in Sydney (Manly), listed by Destination NSW as the ocean-based paddleboard yoga option.
The University of Sydney publishes its online courses and specialisations on Coursera, open to learners anywhere, and Open Universities Australia lists thousands of online subjects.
Raise Foundation runs youth mentoring programs (in-school, digital and community) from its Sydney head office, recruiting volunteer mentors.
The Numismatic Association of Australia lists the Australian Numismatic Society NSW (monthly meetings) and the IBNS Sydney Chapter, which meets monthly at Noble Numismatics, 169 Macquarie Street.
venue: Australian Numismatic Society NSW / IBNS Sydney Chapter

how: Feather and Bone Butchery runs hands-on whole-animal, advanced butchery, home butchery and sausage-making classes on alternate Saturdays at its Marrickville shop; Sydney Community College also offers an Italian sausage-making class.

The Control Line Aircraft Society of NSW lists affiliated clubs including the Sydney Aeromodelling Team (Ashford Reserve, Milperra) and the Ryde-Epping Model Aircraft Club for tethered control-line flying.

Aeromodellers NSW's club finder lists Sydney-area MAAA clubs such as the Macquarie Model Soaring Club (George Christie Playing Fields, Wahroonga) and Cronulla Model Aero Club, with Have-a-Go flying days promoted by the MAAA.
Apnea Australia, a national freediving school, runs Apnea International Stage A/B/C courses and breath-hold clinics with Sydney as a listed location on its course calendar.
Kite For Fun hosts open Windy Kite Day sessions at Boat Harbour beach, Kurnell, where people bring any type of kite and learn from each other.

Sydney Mechanics' School of Arts runs member hobby groups (social chess, bridge, canasta and games, knitting, crafty connections, French conversation), and Meetup lists Sydney interest groups such as Aussie Explorers walking and Sydney Street Photographers.
venue: Sydney Mechanics' School of Arts member groups

how: Alcoholics Anonymous Australia operates an online and in-person meeting finder, with groups meeting across NSW including Sydney.

Taronga Zoo's Free Flight Birds presentation (12pm and 3pm daily, weather permitting) shows the condor and other exotic birds flying against the Sydney Harbour skyline, a captive-bird version of raptor watching.
